LanguageData.LP_WS_SpellZone.label: spell zone
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpellZone.description: A spell area with a lasting effect.
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpellPageA.label: spellbook page (circle 1)
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpellPageA.description: A page torn from someone else's spellbook, holding a circle 1 wizard spell (inspect to see which). A wizard can copy it into their own spellbook at the scroll desk.
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpellPageB.label: spellbook page (circle 2)
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpellPageB.description: A page torn from someone else's spellbook, holding a circle 2 wizard spell (inspect to see which). From wizard level 3, a wizard can copy it into their own spellbook at the scroll desk.
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpellPageC.label: spellbook page (circle 3)
LanguageData.LP_WS_SpellPageC.description: A page torn from someone else's spellbook, holding a circle 3 wizard spell (inspect to see which). From wizard level 5, a wizard can copy it into their own spellbook at the scroll desk.
